definition: יוֺרֶה noun [masculine] early rain , which falls in Palestine from the last of October until the first of December, opposed to מַלְקוֺשׁ : Deut 11:14 ; Jer 5:24 ; Hos 6:3 (where ᵑ0 makes ׳ יו Participle, or Hiph`il Imperfect, but see We ); compare also I. מוֺרֶה . See further Rob Br i, 429 f. Chaplin PEF 1883, 8 ff. Klein ZPV iv, 72 f .
